company_description: Neurocrine Biosciences, Inc. discovers, develops, and commercialize pharmaceuticals for neurological, psychiatric, endocrine, and immunological disorders in the United States and internationally. The company's products include INGREZZA for tardive dyskinesia and chorea associated with Huntington's disease; Orilissa tablets for endometriosis; Oriahnn capsules to treat uterine fibroids; and CRENESSITY to treat congenital adrenal hyperplasia, as well as offers products under the name of ALKINDI and Efmody. Its product candidates in clinical development includes NBI-1076986 to treat movement disorders; Osavampator for inadequate response to treatment in major depressive disorder; NBI-1117568 for the treatment of schizophrenia and bipolar mania; NBI-1117567 for the treatment of Alzheimer's disease; NBI 921355 for the treatment of epilepsy; NBIP-01435 for the treatment of congenital adrenal hyperplasia; NBIP-2118 for the treatment of obesity and related metabolic diseases; and NBI-1070770 to treat major depressive disorder; and NBI-1117570, NBI-1117567, NBI-1117569, NBI-1140675, and NBI-1065890 for neuropsychiatric and neurological conditions. The company also has license and collaboration agreements with Nxera Pharma UK Limited; Takeda Pharmaceutical Company Limited; Xenon Pharmaceuticals Inc.; Voyager Therapeutics, Inc.; Sanofi S.A.; Tanabe Pharma Corporation; and AbbVie Inc. The company was incorporated in 1992 and is headquartered in San Diego, California.

kpis_explanation_fr.INGREZZA Revenue: Ventes nettes générées par INGREZZA (valbenazine), utilisé pour traiter la dyskinésie tardive et la chorée associée à la maladie de Huntington.
kpis_explanation_fr.CRENESSITY Revenue: Ventes nettes de CRENESSITY (crinecerfont), premier traitement de sa catégorie pour l'hyperplasie congénitale des surrénales classique.
kpis_explanation_fr.Total Revenue: Revenu total généré par toutes les activités de l'entreprise, ventes de produits et revenus de collaboration.
kpis_explanation_fr.Gross Margin: Pourcentage du revenu restant après déduction du coût des ventes, reflétant l'efficacité de production.
kpis_explanation_fr.R&D as % Revenue: Pourcentage du revenu alloué à la recherche et au développement de nouveaux traitements et thérapies.
kpis_explanation_fr.Operating Expenses: Coûts totaux liés aux opérations, incluant R&D, frais SG&A et coût des revenus, hors éléments non opérationnels.
kpis_explanation_fr.Collaboration Revenues: Revenus issus des accords de partenariat avec d'autres entreprises, principalement royalties sur les ventes de partenaires.
